summary.text: Avery Anderson is a Republican state representative from Kansas House District 72 who has represented the district since January 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Anderson chairs the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Avery Anderson earned a B.S. in political science and government from the University of Kansas in 2019.
His career experience includes internships with a Kansas state representative and with the Sedgwick County District Attorney's Office.
Anderson succeeded Tim Hodge in the District 72 seat and took office on January 11, 2021.

In the 2025-2026 session Anderson was assigned to the Appropriations, House Transportation, Transportation and Public Safety Budget, and State Building Construction committees and chairs the Transportation and Public Safety Budget Committee.
He faces Democrat Matthew Smith in the general election.
